input.quote: 13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position in full. The subscription grant in 13.1 runs to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (no written-notice condition needed), and 13.2 makes paid-up/embedded licences perpetual, irrevocable and fully paid for Customer and its Affiliates, with contractor support permitted. Nothing in the document makes the licence revocable at Vendor's discretion: 13.3 permits revocation or suspension only during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity, which is narrower than the preferred "uncured material breach" standard and therefore favourable to us. Transferability to successors is satisfied by 13.3 read with 24.1, which allows Customer to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all assets without Vendor's consent. No redline required.
